phaseNumbering: Phases 1-4 were each scoped and delivered as a single journey step from docs/MASTER-PLAN.md §4 (1=Enquiry/Intent, 2=Extract Dates & Location, 3=Determine Vehicle, 4=Ask Missing Information), not the original 10-phase infra grouping below. Phase ids 6-10 below are still the original, pre-journey-step-granularity plan, kept for reference — their scope/ids will be reconciled with the real journey-step sequence (Steps 5-19) as work reaches them, same as phases 1-4 already turned out to differ from this document's original phase 1-4 grouping. Phase id 5 has now been reconciled too, but NOT to journey Step 5 (Eligibility, per MASTER-PLAN.md §4) — it was explicitly requested and built ahead of Eligibility as just the WhatsApp slice of the original phase-5 grouping (see docs/PHASE-5.md §0). Two pieces of the original plan are therefore still open and unnumbered: journey Step 5 (Eligibility) itself, and the rest of the original phase-5 grouping (documents, payments, CRM, fulfilment, Web-chat/Email channels) — both remain PENDING in spirit, without an id yet, until picked up.

packages/ai/step4: RequiredFieldsEvaluator (pure, zero I/O; narrow IntentSnapshot/DateLocationSnapshot/VehicleSnapshot inputs; COMPLETE/NEEDS_INFO/EXPIRED/NOT_APPLICABLE + NOT_PROVIDED/AMBIGUOUS/INVALID reasons), clarificationPromptBuilder (deterministic, template-based, Oxford-comma joined), MissingInfoOrchestrator

phases.name: Security Engine & Zero Trust
phases.goal: Zero-trust layering verified by tests (WAF -> AuthN -> AuthZ -> Tenant -> Sandbox -> Egress -> DB policy -> Encrypted data).
deliverables: Edge: Redis rate limiting + WAF rules (body size, schema, IP lists, bot signals)
AuthN: OIDC/OAuth2, <=15-min access tokens, rotating refresh, step-up/MFA for admin
AuthZ: RBAC + ABAC policy engine (tenant, ownership, journey state, tier) in one middleware and in services
Tenant isolation: RLS on every table, per-connection tenant context, cross-tenant negative tests
AI sandbox: tool permission matrix, egress allowlist, injection defences, output DLP
Data: TLS, field-level PII encryption, secrets management, key rotation runbook
Detection & response: anomaly rules, automatic restricted response, security event stream, T4 escalation
CI: Semgrep, dependency scan, gitleaks, Trivy image scan, ZAP baseline
